name: Indian English vocabulary (hand-written)
verdict_reason: Written by hand for this repository, so there is no third-party licence to follow or credit; the app credits third-party sources only.
attribution: Festivals, places, foods and abbreviations of Indian and Kerala English (Onam, Munnar, biryani, PNR), written for this keyboard. No third-party data.
used_for: Kept in the English lexicon (en.fst) whatever their Wikipedia count, so autocorrect leaves them alone (lexbuild --english-list).
